notes: Twin of METRICS.md. Code reads ids, names, units, statuses, prerequisites, reference ranges and thresholds from here; algorithms live in METRICS.md.
statusDefault = the status the engine emits when all prerequisites hold and the metric has passed synthetic validation (V1). statusTarget = the status after real-footage validation passes.
validationLevel = the level actually achieved. All metrics are V0 until the first synthetic matrix run (METRICS.md section 5) passes; CI then promotes them to V1 through a reviewed change.

Emitted status = min(statusTarget, statusCeilingByValidationLevel[validationLevel]), then downgraded per value by the rules in METRICS.md section 3. Status order: unavailable < experimental < estimated < measured. player-entered is outside the ladder.
Experimental values are hidden unless the profile's experimental toggle is on, never appear in headlines, and are never cited by coaching text.
Heights are ball-centre heights. Ratios are of the player's standing height. Positive forward = into the court from the start toe (front toe at toss release).

statusCeilingByValidationLevel.V2: measured for relative and timing metrics (kind session-spread, timing ids); estimated for absolute spatial metrics

VIEW_NOT_SUPPORTED.unlockHint: Film from the side, on your hitting-arm side, to see this.

VIEW_MISMATCH.meaning: Detected view differs from the declared view
VIEW_MISMATCH.unlockHint: This clip doesn't look like the view you chose. Check where the phone is.

FPS_TOO_LOW.meaning: Below the metric's minimum real frame rate
FPS_TOO_LOW.unlockHint: Record at 60 fps (120 fps or more for speed).

TIME_BASE_UNKNOWN.meaning: Possible rendered slow motion; gravity check could not fix it
TIME_BASE_UNKNOWN.unlockHint: Import the original slow-motion file, or record in the app.

FRAMES_DROPPED.meaning: More than 10% of frames missing in the serve window

PLAYER_HEIGHT_MISSING.meaning: A cm, m or km/h value needs the entered height
PLAYER_HEIGHT_MISSING.unlockHint: Add your height in Profile to see centimetres.

BODY_NOT_UPRIGHT.meaning: No standing frames to measure body height
BODY_NOT_UPRIGHT.unlockHint: Stand tall for a second before each serve.

FEET_NOT_VISIBLE.meaning: Foot landmarks missing or cut off
FEET_NOT_VISIBLE.unlockHint: Keep your feet in the frame.

POSE_LOW_QUALITY.meaning: Tracking quality below 0.5 where the metric needs it
POSE_LOW_QUALITY.unlockHint: Make sure you're the only person near your serving spot, with the light behind the camera.

OCCLUDED.meaning: Needed landmark hidden at the event
OCCLUDED.unlockHint: Try the other side of the court so nothing blocks the view.

BALL_NOT_TRACKED.meaning: Toss track missing or under 6 detections
BALL_NOT_TRACKED.unlockHint: Toss against sky, a fence or a plain windbreak; avoid trees behind you.

APEX_OUT_OF_FRAME.meaning: Apex above the frame and not bracketed
APEX_OUT_OF_FRAME.unlockHint: Move the phone back a step or raise it a little so the whole toss fits.

RELEASE_NOT_FOUND.unlockHint: We couldn't see this moment clearly on this serve.

CONTACT_NOT_FOUND.unlockHint: We couldn't see this moment clearly on this serve.

LANDING_NOT_FOUND.unlockHint: We couldn't see this moment clearly on this serve.

NO_CONTACT.unlockHint: Swing and miss: not counted in contact stats.

AUDIO_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: No audio track, or unusable audio
AUDIO_UNAVAILABLE.unlockHint: Speed from sound needs the clip's audio.

BOUNCE_NOT_HEARD.meaning: No bounce onset in the expected window
BOUNCE_NOT_HEARD.unlockHint: The bounce was too quiet to hear.

NOT_ENTERED.meaning: Player has not tagged outcomes or entries
NOT_ENTERED.unlockHint: Tag your serves (in, net, long, wide) in review.

NEEDS_CALIBRATION.meaning: Rear auto outcomes need the four-corner tap
NEEDS_CALIBRATION.unlockHint: Tap the four corners of the service box.

CAMERA_MOVED.unlockHint: Fix the phone firmly; it moved during recording.

CAMERA_TILTED.meaning: Pitch or roll above 10 degrees and uncorrectable
CAMERA_TILTED.unlockHint: Keep the phone level; the guide turns green.

SCALE_INCONSISTENT.meaning: Gravity-based and body-based scales disagree by more than 15%
SCALE_INCONSISTENT.unlockHint: Check your height in Profile. If this was slow motion, import the original.

TOO_FEW_SERVES.meaning: n below the minimum for this aggregate
TOO_FEW_SERVES.unlockHint: Record at least {n} serves from one side.

RANGE_TOO_WIDE.meaning: Speed range wider than 35% of its midpoint
RANGE_TOO_WIDE.unlockHint: This footage can't pin the speed down closely enough.

METHODS_DISAGREE.meaning: The two speed methods do not overlap
METHODS_DISAGREE.unlockHint: Our two speed checks disagreed, so we're not showing either.

EXPERIMENTAL_HIDDEN.unlockHint: Turn on experimental metrics in Profile to see this.

NOT_MEASURABLE.unlockHint: Spin needs cameras shooting about 1,000 frames a second or a radar tracker; phone video can't measure it. Log the serve type you meant instead.

LOW_LIGHT.meaning: Exposure or backlight too poor for pose
LOW_LIGHT.unlockHint: Put the sun or court lights behind the camera.

FLICKER.unlockHint: Under lights, record at 50 or 100 fps if your phone allows it.

MOTION_BLUR.meaning: Ball streak longer than 3 diameters near contact
MOTION_BLUR.unlockHint: More light, or a shorter shutter in the app's recorder.

UNMATCHED.unlockHint: Compare sessions from the same side, view and serve.

metrics.name: Serves
metrics.question: How many serves did I hit?
metrics.referenceNote: No reference needed. Volume feeds load-flag (research 03 [S43]).

validation.syntheticThreshold: precision and recall >= 99% across families; 100% on S0
validation.realMethod: Two annotators count serves on >= 300 real serves

metrics.name: Re-tosses
metrics.question: How often did I catch a bad toss?
metrics.referenceNote: None.

metrics.name: Toss height
metrics.question: How high do I toss?

referenceRange.population: High-performance men, mean UTR about 10.7, n = 10

references.population: Nationally ranked junior men, 181 cm, n = 13 (about 1.88 x height, our arithmetic)

metrics.referenceNote: No published values for recreational players. Shown as context, never as a target.
metrics.uncertainty: Random: fit + unseen lateral offset leak (sigma 0.15 m). Shared: floor row, body-height session part 0.8%, tilt. Persistent: body-height bias 1.8%, entered height 1.2%. 95% band about +/-15 cm.

validation.syntheticThreshold: median |error| <= 2.5% of height; p95 <= 5% of height
validation.realMethod: V2 annotated apex frame and ball; V3 4 m calibration pole in the server's plane
validation.realThreshold: V2 MAE <= 3% of height; V3 MAE <= 10 cm, ICC(2,1) >= 0.75

metrics.name: Toss in front
metrics.question: Is my toss in front of me?
metrics.referenceNote: No measured values for recreational players. Coaching: toss into the court, in front of the front toe; drill target 30-50 cm in front (research 04 F3). Elite adolescents contacted flat serves about 17 cm further forward than kick serves (research 03 [S35]).

display.example: about 35 cm in front of your front toe

metrics.uncertainty: Random: x-fit, toe jitter 0.01 BH, lateral-offset leak. Shared: scale 0.8%, toe landmark bias 0.015 BH. Persistent: scale. 95% band about +/-10 cm.

validation.realMethod: V2 annotated apex and toe; V3 two-view triangulation
validation.realThreshold: V2 MAE <= 6 cm; V3 MAE <= 8 cm

metrics.name: Toss left-right
metrics.question: Does my toss drift left or right?
metrics.referenceNote: Coaching: about '1 o'clock' for a right-hander; a toss directly overhead is a coaching concern for the shoulder (research 03 [S1]).

display.example: about 15 cm to your hitting side

validation.syntheticTruth: lateral apex offset from frontToeAtRelease, signed to the hitting side

metrics.name: Ball drop before contact
metrics.question: How far does the ball fall before I hit it?
metrics.referenceNote: No recreational values. No direction is better. Coaching flag offered above 100 cm (beyond mean + 1.5 SD of the junior sample) [Our inference].
metrics.uncertainty: Physics path: sigma = g * dt * sigma_dt (about 1.4 cm at 60 fps with audio). Image path used as a cross-check.

validation.syntheticThreshold: MAE <= 3 cm; time MAE <= 6 ms at 60 fps
validation.realMethod: V2 annotated apex and contact frames; V3 240 fps reference camera

metrics.name: Toss height consistency
metrics.question: Is my toss becoming more consistent (height)?

referenceRange.population: Professional women, within-player SD at zenith (vertical), n = 8 players x 5 serves

metrics.referenceNote: Authors judged a perfectly repeatable toss too strict a demand. Experienced servers stabilise the vertical dimension most (research 03 [S29]). No recreational values. Side view: unseen lateral scatter leaks into apparent height (about 0.3 cm per cm at 7 m).

validation.syntheticTruth: SD of realised plan.apex[z] over the same serves
validation.syntheticThreshold: |error| <= max(1.5 cm, 15%) in >= 90% of 20-serve blocks; monotonic in sdScale
validation.realMethod: V2 test-retest (two 12-serve blocks); V3 two-view triangulated SD
validation.realThreshold: V2 typical error <= 25% of median spread; V3 within 20%

metrics.name: Toss front-back consistency
metrics.question: Is my toss landing in the same place front-to-back?

referenceRange.population: Professional women, within-player forward/back SD at zenith, n = 8 x 5

metrics.referenceNote: Experienced servers allow more forward-back variation than vertical (research 03 [S29]). No recreational values.

validation.syntheticTruth: SD of realised plan.apex[x] - frontToeAtRelease[x] over the same serves
validation.syntheticThreshold: |error| <= max(2 cm, 20%) in >= 90% of 20-serve blocks; monotonic in sdScale

metrics.name: Toss side-to-side consistency
metrics.question: Is my toss landing in the same place side to side?

referenceRange.population: Professional women, within-player lateral SD at zenith, n = 8 x 5

validation.syntheticTruth: SD of the realised lateral apex offset

metrics.name: Contact height
metrics.question: How high do I make contact?
metrics.referenceNote: Direction of travel, not a target. Impact height correlates with serve speed (rho 0.75-0.78; research 03 [S28]). Recreational players about 13 cm lower in a weak case study (research 05 [S47]).
metrics.uncertainty: Random: contact timing x ball speed (about 1.7 cm at 5 ms), fit, lateral leak (sigma 0.15 m). Body-height bias dominates absolute values (about 4.6 cm 1-sigma at 1.75 m) and cancels in the player's own comparisons.

validation.realMethod: V2 annotated contact frame and ball; V3 pole or 240 fps reference

metrics.name: Contact height consistency
metrics.question: Do I hit the ball at the same height each time?

referenceRange.population: Professional women, impact height within-player SD, n = 8 x 5

metrics.referenceNote: Lower impact-height variability strengthened the strength-to-speed link in juniors (research 03 [S28]).

validation.syntheticTruth: SD of plan.contact[z] over the same serves

metrics.name: Contact in front
metrics.question: Am I hitting the ball out in front?
metrics.referenceNote: No numeric recreational or elite reference in our research. Flat contact about 17 cm further forward than kick in elite adolescents (research 03 [S35]). Coaching: contact in front and into the court (research 04 F6, F11).

display.example: about 40 cm in front of your front toe

validation.realThreshold: V2 MAE <= 6 cm; V3 MAE <= 10 cm

metrics.name: Toss-to-hit time
metrics.question: How long from toss to hit?
metrics.referenceNote: No recreational values and no 'correct' tempo; any ideal is coaching interpretation (research 05 section 6.2).

validation.realMethod: V2 annotated release and contact frames

metrics.name: Rhythm consistency
metrics.question: Is my rhythm the same every serve?
metrics.referenceNote: No numeric values. Elite women: variable toss but very consistent timing (research 03 [S24]). More variability went with lower speed and accuracy (research 03 [S30]). Experts rate rhythm reliably from 2D video (research 03 [S33]). At 30 fps the value is flagged near the measurement limit.

validation.syntheticTruth: SD of truth release-to-contact over the same serves
validation.syntheticThreshold: |error| <= max(10 ms, 20%) at 60 fps; monotonic in sdScale

metrics.name: Pause at the top
metrics.question: Do I pause at the top?
metrics.referenceNote: No numeric reference. Internal-rotation speed about 20% higher with no pause than after a 1.5 s pause (research 03 [S2], lab mechanism); applying it to a trophy pause is coaching interpretation. Coaching flag above 500 ms [Our inference].

validation.realMethod: V2 two annotators mark trophy start and end
validation.realThreshold: MAE <= 80 ms after inter-rater agreement is reported

metrics.name: Knee bend (hip drop)
metrics.question: Am I using my legs?

method.side: hip drop (mid-hip) at maximum loading, normalised by standing leg length
method.rear: 2D knee angle at trophy, hip drop as cross-check

referenceRange.population: National to professional players, pooled over 11 studies

metrics.referenceNote: Knee restriction to 10 deg cut ball speed about 15-17% at all levels (research 03 [S7]). Front knee > 15 deg recommended (research 03 [S1], coaching). Low knee flexion and arm load: conflicting evidence (research 03 [S3], [S9]). Degrees are never displayed (D5).

validation.syntheticTruth: band of the realised front-knee flexion at times.trophyEndS
validation.syntheticThreshold: >= 90% agreement where truth is >= 5 deg from a cut point; 0 low/high swaps; unclear <= 25%
validation.realMethod: Two blinded coaches label three levels

metrics.name: Trunk tilt at loading
metrics.question: How much do I tilt back as I load?

bandThresholds.unit: deg lean away from the net at trophy (image plane)

referenceRange.population: National to professional players, pooled over 6 studies (definitions vary)

metrics.referenceNote: Band cut points are our inference (about mean - 2 SD and mean + 1.5 SD). The high band feeds coaching's back-comfort logic, never a diagnosis.

validation.syntheticTruth: truth mid-hip to mid-shoulder angle at times.trophyEndS, 3D and camera-projected
validation.syntheticThreshold: >= 85% agreement where truth is >= 4 deg from a cut point
validation.realMethod: Two blinded coaches label three levels

metrics.name: Landing distance
metrics.question: Am I driving into the court?
metrics.referenceNote: No established norms for recreational players (research 05 section 6.7). Measured from where the front toe started, not from the baseline. Coaching: landing behind the baseline suggests no forward drive (research 04 F9).

display.example: you land about 45 cm in front of where your front toe started

validation.syntheticTruth: landing-foot toe x at times.landingS - frontToeAtRelease[x]
validation.syntheticThreshold: MAE <= 8 cm; p95 <= 15 cm; landing time MAE <= 1 frame

metrics.name: Serve shape repeatability
metrics.question: How similar are my serves to each other?
metrics.referenceNote: Our own composite; no external reference. More variable movement went with lower speed and accuracy (research 03 [S30]).

validation.syntheticThreshold: Spearman >= 0.9 vs sdScale per profile; seeds at equal sdScale within 5 points
validation.realThreshold: to be set after V2 pilot

metrics.name: Serves in
metrics.question: How many serves went in?
metrics.referenceNote: See first-serve-in-rate and second-serve-in-rate for level data.

validation.syntheticTruth: n/a for player entry; rear auto: flight bounce vs service box
validation.syntheticThreshold: rear auto >= 95% correct for bounces > 30 cm from lines
validation.realMethod: Rear auto vs annotated video plus on-court observer
validation.realThreshold: >= 95% for bounces > 30 cm from lines (research 05 section 11.3)

metrics.name: First serves in
metrics.question: Am I getting more first serves in?

referenceRange.population: SwingVision users, NTRP 3.0-5.0, match play, combined genders, 250,000+ sessions

metrics.referenceNote: First-serve % barely moves with level, so it is a weak progress headline (research 09 section 4.1). Detecting a 10-point rise needs about 190 serves per side.

metrics.name: Second serves in
metrics.question: Is my second serve reliable?

referenceRange.population: SwingVision users, NTRP 3.0-5.0, match play, combined genders

metrics.name: Double faults
metrics.question: How many double faults?
metrics.referenceNote: Match play, not practice. A session tally may enter the count directly.

metrics.name: Where serves land
metrics.question: Where are my serves landing?
metrics.zoneDefinition: Service box width (4.115 m) split into thirds; the third nearest the centre line is T [Our inference]. Too close to call when P(zone) < 0.8.
metrics.referenceNote: No recreational reference. Placement, closeness to lines and speed classified professional aces with 87% accuracy (research 03 [S21]).

display.example: T 6, body 3, wide 4; 8 of 13 on target

validation.realMethod: Rear auto vs annotated video and observer

metrics.name: Serve types
metrics.question: Which serves did I practise?
metrics.referenceNote: None. Intended type is a stratum key.

metrics.name: Speed (experimental)
metrics.question: Roughly how fast was that serve?
metrics.prerequisitesNote: Common prerequisites; each method adds its own below.

A.name: Side-view outgoing track
A.notes: >= 3 clean outgoing detections 4-50 ms after contact; line-fit residual RMS <= 0.5 ball radius; out-of-plane angle 0-25 deg (0-15 deg when zone tagged and yaw check passes).

B.name: Audio flight time
B.notes: Bounce onset 0.3-1.2 s after contact with SNR >= 10 dB; serve tagged in; sound-travel corrected; path 14-19 m.

metrics.referenceNote: Context only: SwingVision average first-serve speed 96-120 km/h at NTRP 3.0-5.0 (research 01 [S7], vendor claim; average reads about 20% below radar, research 05 [S35]). Lab radar flat first serves: beginners 107, intermediates 149 km/h (research 03 [S7]). No 'Did it work?' verdicts on speed.

aggregation.ci: shared relative error (2 sigma, not averaged) plus random / sqrt(n)

validation.syntheticThreshold: range coverage >= 90% (target 95%); median |midpoint error| <= 5%; A unavailable below 120 fps in 100%
validation.realMethod: V3 radar (+/-1 mph class) behind the server in line with the serve; 200+ serves

metrics.name: Radar speed (you logged)
metrics.question: What did my radar say?
metrics.referenceNote: Pairs with speed-experimental become personal validation data.

metrics.name: Spin
metrics.question: How much spin did I use?
metrics.referenceNote: Serve spin is about 1,000-5,000 rpm (research 05 [S43]); at 240 fps the ball turns 75-125 deg between frames; even Hawk-Eye estimates had an error SD of about 540 rpm (research 05 [S44]).

display.example: Spin needs cameras shooting about 1,000 frames a second or a radar tracker; phone video can't measure it. Log the serve type you meant instead.

validation.syntheticThreshold: must be unavailable in 100% of cases

metrics.name: Capture quality
metrics.question: Can I trust this session's numbers?

rules.usable: any warning and >= 70% of serves analysable
rules.poor: a session-level block (view, time-base, fps) or < 50% of serves analysable

metrics.referenceNote: Adapted from research 06 section 14; thresholds are initial.

display.example: Fair: toss left the frame on 3 of 12 serves

validation.syntheticThreshold: each flag fires with >= 95% sensitivity in its trigger scenario; <= 5% false alarms on S0

metrics.name: Fatigue check
metrics.question: Did my serve drop off as I got tired?
metrics.rule: Theil-Sen slope of contact-height-ratio on serve order; predicted drop over the session >= 0.025 of height and one-sided 90% bootstrap bound of slope < 0. Confidence 0.6, or 0.8 if toss-height-spread in the last third >= 1.5 x the first third.
metrics.referenceNote: After a 3-hour match, advanced players' impact height fell about 4 cm (2.65 to 2.61 m) (research 03 [S14]; research 05 [S50]).

display.example: Your contact point dropped in the last part of the session, which can be a sign of tiring. A shorter block next time?

validation.syntheticTruth: scenario with an injected linear contact-height decline
validation.syntheticThreshold: fires >= 90% when the decline >= 0.035 of height over 20 serves; <= 5% false alarms with no decline

metrics.name: Serving volume check
metrics.question: Am I ramping up my serving too fast?
metrics.rule: Acute:chronic ratio (last 7 days / weekly mean of last 28 days) > 1.5 and >= 100 serves in the last 7 days. Counts from serve-count plus player-entered match serves.
metrics.referenceNote: Ratio above 1.5 went with a hazard ratio of about 2.8 for new injury in adult high-performance players (research 03 [S43]); transfer to recreational players is our inference.

display.example: You've served a lot more this week than usual. Build up gradually.
